in_hindi.name: पूल्कित
in_hindi.long_meaning: पूल् (Pūl) - चंद्र (Moon) कित (Kit) - समान (Similar) सुन्दर (Sundar) - Beautiful

in_marathi.name: Pulkit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pulkit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Pulkit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pulkita', which means 'Moon, Wisdom'. This name signifies the divine connection between the individual and the cosmic energies of the moon, bestowing upon the bearer a deep sense of intuition and wisdom.
